variables.name: NODE_ENV
variables.description: Runtime mode validated as development, test, or production.

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: HTTP port injected by Cloud Run or the invoking process.

variables.name: CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
variables.description: Explicit comma-separated frontend origins; wildcard production origin is forbidden.

variables.name: PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL
variables.description: Public API origin made available to the browser at runtime.

variables.name: GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT
variables.requiredWhen: A Google provider adapter is enabled
variables.description: Google Cloud project identifier; authentication uses workload identity.

variables.name: GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION
variables.description: Google provider location, normally global for the MVP.

variables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
variables.description: OpenAI credential injected from Secret Manager or an approved runtime secret tool.

variables.name: QWEN_API_KEY
variables.requiredWhen: The optional Qwen-MT adapter is enabled
variables.description: Qwen credential for stretch scope only.
